POST /api/auth/login/user correctly blocks pending users with 403 and Turkish message 'admin onayı bekliyor'

Admin approval endpoint POST /api/auth/admin/user-approval-requests/{id}/approve correctly enables user login
Owner-scope isolation working on bot-profiles: user B cannot list or update user A's bots
Owner-scope isolation working on risk-policies: user B cannot list or update user A's policies
Owner-scope isolation working on pipeline: user B cannot start/stop user A's bots (returns 404)
Owner-scope isolation working on dashboard: user sees only their own bot/policy counts
GET /api/auth/me regression passing - returns correct user info for authenticated users
User registration -> pending -> admin approval -> login flow fully working
User registration -> pending -> admin rejection -> blocked login flow fully working
All owner-scoped routers (bot_profiles, risk_policies, paper_positions, pipeline, exchange, dashboard) use is_admin_role check for scope filtering
